note: The board film for Client Support (14 October 2026). Every name and number on screen is made up. build-boardfilm.py renders the film's page from this file; voice-lines.py voices the lines and times the scenes.

scenes.headline: The board, for Client Support
scenes.sub: Your calls, the call-backs, and naming an agent
scenes.line: This is the client transition board, as Client Support sees it. Your calls, the call-backs, and naming an agent.

scenes.headline: Your number, your password
scenes.line: Open Ricky Rampersad branch dot com, slash orphan management, on a phone or a laptop. Sign in with your agent number, or your first name, and your password. The device keeps you signed in until you press Sign out.

scenes.headline: Your list, in order
scenes.line: You open on Your calls. Your own list, in order, with why to call, and the number to tap.

scenes.headline: Everything before you dial
scenes.line: Open a client to see their numbers, where they live, their family, what they told us, and why we are calling.

scenes.headline: Log it, and flag the call-back
scenes.line: After every try, press Log call. Choose what happened, and write one line for the file. If the client needs a licensed agent, flag the call-back. It goes to the top of the branch manager's Urgent list.

scenes.headline: Take details. Never advise.

rows.i: the e-mail, spelled back; a new number or address

rows.b: Advise on cover, or on what a policy pays
rows.i: never: a licensed agent calls them back

rows.b: Flag a call-back for a licensed agent
rows.i: anything about what a policy pays, or changing cover

scenes.line: On the call, you take details, and you never advise. Anything about what a policy pays, or changing cover, goes to a licensed agent.

scenes.headline: The family stays together
scenes.line: On the Agents tab, each household on your board carries one suggested agent. One press names the whole household. The agent gets a brief by e-mail.

scenes.headline: Your name on the record
scenes.line: To move a client, choose Reassign. Your name goes on the history, with the date, so everyone can see who moved it, and when.

scenes.headline: Everything you logged
scenes.line: Your work shows everything you logged, today and this week, with your notes. The branch sees the same.

scenes.headline: Log every try. Flag the call-back. Name the household.
